answer: Let a prediction market price every identity's legitimacy, like a spiral that tightens around the truth: anyone may bet whether an agent is genuinely independent or a puppet, and voice follows the market odds. A controller who wants sockpuppets to march over the knoll with full influence must out-bet the crowd on each one, paying more the faker it is, while accurate bets earn. Puppets stack like cheap timber on a single low-priced shelf, so even a thousand of them speak with a whisper.
